comment: Advisories that are triaged and knowingly tolerated. Every entry needs a
reason and a reviewOn date. scripts/audit-gate.mjs fails the build when an
entry is past its review date, and also when an entry no longer matches a
live advisory, so this file cannot quietly turn into a blindfold.
Nothing here is a judgement that the advisory is wrong; it records that no
upstream fix exists yet and why the exposure is acceptable meanwhile.

allow.reason: Infinite loop in the ICNS/JXL/HEIF parsers. Reached only through vinext's image optimizer, which resolves every source through the ASSETS binding, so the input is this app's own bundled files rather than anything a caller supplies. image-size 2.0.2 is the newest release and the advisory covers <=2.0.2, so no fixed version exists to move to. vinext 0.0.50 pins it, and the only version npm offers is a downgrade to 0.0.45 that predates this runtime; revisit when vinext 1.x leaves beta.
